response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus IS NULL OR t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'not in Maintenance' filter is applied at the telescope row level, so only non-Maintenance telescopes are averaged and counted. Telescopes with a NULL equipstatus are kept because they are not in Maintenance.
Ties in telescope count are broken arbitrarily because the request gives no secondary sort.
